recipe.variant: Anima Base v1.0 + the official Turbo LoRA v0.2 (the template's turbo switch on): 8 steps, cfg 1, euler/simple, 1024x1024

unet_name.note: the Anima diffusion model the Turbo LoRA patches: Comfy Cloud has anima-base-v1.0, anima-preview3-base, anima-preview2 and anima-preview; the template pairs the LoRA with anima-base-v1.0

prompt.note: Danbooru tags (lowercase, spaces not underscores), natural language, or both; tag order: quality/meta/year/safety, 1girl/1boy, character, series, @artist, general tags

steps.note: the template's turbo value is 8; the card gives 8-12 steps for the distilled Anima-Turbo

cfg.note: 1 with the Turbo LoRA (template turbo value; card: Anima-Turbo 'Use at CFG 1'); at cfg 1 the negative has no effect

sampler.note: the sampling method (ComfyUI's sampler list: euler, er_sde, euler_ancestral, dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu, …)

scheduler.note: the noise schedule (simple, normal, karras, beta, beta57, …)

width.note: the card: 'Works at resolutions between 512^2 and 1536^2 pixels'; the template rounds to multiples of 16

lora_strength.note: the Turbo LoRA's strength; the template uses 1

recipe.defaults_note: The template's subgraph flattened with its 'turbo' PrimitiveBoolean at true: the ComfySwitchNodes pick UNETLoader -> LoraLoaderModelOnly(anima-turbo-lora-v0.2, 1) -> KSampler, steps 8 and cfg 1 (the 'on' PrimitiveInt/PrimitiveFloat values); everything else as t2i-base.
